title: Exact contraction alone does not provide a valid evaluation lift
situation: Abstract conditional point semantics over identity-related integer rings with zero ideals; admissible evaluations are an additional premise. This is not a standard algebraic-point elimination theorem.

exact_contraction.formula: For every g, g = 0 iff identity(g) = 0
exact_contraction.justification: identity embedding and the same zero ideal at both endpoints

inputs.ideal_vanishing: Every value equals the distinguished Unit zero

attempted_conclusion: Infer that every valid target point has a valid source lift solely from exact ideal contraction.

expected.reason: The target constant Unit point exists, while every source point would require the always-False validity predicate. Ideal equality supplies no valid evaluation lift.
